svg.title: FieldLens equipment evidence states - original UX concept
svg.desc: Three equipment inspector states: source-documented geometry, externally researched catalog geometry, and an explicitly generic unknown asset. A separate unlocated rule prevents invented installation depths. All drawings are illustrative.
svg.text: Equipment: reveal the evidence, not just the shape
Original FieldLens UX reference / illustrative components / not dimensional or installation data
1 / DOCUMENTED
2 / CATALOG MATCH
3 / GENERIC ONLY
Source-backed reconstruction
Researched product geometry
Unknown equipment
Illustrative profile; not a dimensional drawing
Datasheet
Match the exact manufacturer / variant / revision
Display placeholder / dimensions not established
Dimensions + units from source claims
Placement tied to a validated interval
Configuration date and revision visible
Open original drawing / page / table
Calculation eligibility is attribute-specific.
Validation is required even for source records.
Cited specifications, not installed truth
Show source URL, date and matching evidence
Retain conflicting or ambiguous variants
Source evidence must still establish placement
A catalog model does not prove installation,
depth, orientation, quantity or historical variant.
State what is missing in plain language
Type, dimensions or identity may be unknown
Label shape as generic, not "AI reconstructed"
Keep the supporting mention accessible
Generic sizes are presentation choices only.
Exclude them from engineering calculations.
Placement is a separate evidence question in every tier.
Known interval: render against the validated trajectory. Unknown interval: keep an unlocated asset in the inspector/list.
Never guess a depth to make the scene look complete. Every state remains inspectable and carries its source or missing-data explanation.
